<blockquote>
<p><strong>Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song (CKKS) Scheme</strong> - 首个支持近似算术的高效同态加密方案</p>
<p><strong>阅读本文需要一定的代数学基础</strong></p>
<p>本文将介绍CKKS构造同态，密钥生成，加解密，加乘法同构，旋转，自举的数学原理</p>
</blockquote>

</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="引言">引言</h2>
<h3 id="同态加密的发展">同态加密的发展</h3>
<p>同态加密（Homomorphic Encryption, HE）允许在密文上直接进行计算，而无需解密。这一特性使得云计算场景下的数据隐私保护成为可能。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{方案} &amp; \text{提出时间} &amp; \text{特性} \\
\hline
\text{RSA} &amp; 1978 &amp; \text{仅支持乘法同态} \\
\text{Paillier} &amp; 1999 &amp; \text{仅支持加法同态} \\
\text{Gentry} &amp; 2009 &amp; \text{首个全同态加密方案（FHE）} \\
\text{BGV} &amp; 2012 &amp; \text{基于RLWE的分层FHE} \\
\text{BFV} &amp; 2012 &amp; \text{适用于精确整数运算} \\
\textbf{CKKS} &amp; \textbf{2017} &amp; \textbf{首个支持近似实数运算的FHE}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="ckks-的核心创新">CKKS 的核心创新</h3>
<p><strong>CKKS（Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song）</strong> 方案于 2017 年提出，其核心创新在于：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>支持近似算术</strong>：可以加密实数/复数向量，计算结果与明文计算存在可控误差</li>
<li><strong>SIMD 风格批处理</strong>：单次加密可处理 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 个数据，支持向量化的并行计算</li>
<li><strong>高效的旋转操作</strong>：支持密文向量的循环移位</li>
<li><strong>重缩放（Rescaling）技术</strong>：管理噪声增长，支持任意深度的计算</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="应用场景">应用场景</h3>
<p>CKKS 特别适合以下场景：</p>
<ul>
<li>机器学习推理（加密神经网络）</li>
<li>隐私保护的统计分析</li>
<li>基因组数据分析</li>
<li>金融数据的安全计算</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="数学基础">数学基础</h2>
<h3 id="21-环与多项式">2.1 环与多项式</h3>
<h4 id="211-分圆多项式">2.1.1 分圆多项式</h4>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(N = 2^d\)</span> 为 2 的幂次，<span class="math inline">\(m = 2N\)</span>。第 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 个分圆多项式为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Phi_m(X) = X^N + 1
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>分圆域</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_m)\)</span> 是有理数域添加本原 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 次单位根 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta_m = e^{2\pi i/m}\)</span> 得到的扩张。</p>
<h4 id="212-多项式环">2.1.2 多项式环</h4>
<p>定义两个重要的多项式环：</p>
<p><strong>原始多项式环</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N + 1)
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>这个符号表示<strong>商环</strong>（Quotient Ring），下面分步拆解：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{符号} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
\mathbb{Z}[X] &amp; \text{整数系数多项式环：所有形如 } a_0 + a_1 X + \cdots + a_d X^d \text{ 的多项式，系数 } a_i \in \mathbb{Z} \\
(X^N + 1) &amp; \text{由多项式 } X^N + 1 \text{ 生成的理想（ideal）} \\
/ &amp; \text{商运算：将环中相差一个理想元素的元素视为等价}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 中的元素是<strong>次数小于 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 的整数系数多项式</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a_0 + a_1 X + a_2 X^2 + \cdots + a_{N-1} X^{N-1}, \quad a_i \in \mathbb{Z}
\]</div><p></p><p>且满足约束关系 <span class="math inline">\(X^N \equiv -1 \pmod{X^N + 1}\)</span>，即所有 <span class="math inline">\(X^N\)</span> 都可以用 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span> 替换。</p>
<p><strong>运算示例</strong>（设 <span class="math inline">\(N=4\)</span>，即在 <span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^4+1)\)</span> 中）：</p>
<ul>
<li>加法：<span class="math inline">\((1 + 2X) + (3 - X) = 4 + X\)</span></li>
<li>乘法降次：<span class="math inline">\(X^2 \cdot X^3 = X^5 = X \cdot X^4 \equiv -X\)</span></li>
<li>幂运算：<span class="math inline">\(X^6 = X^2 \cdot X^4 \equiv -X^2\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>可以将商群理解为将正规子群 N“压缩”为单位元”，即在 G 中把 N 内的元素视作同一个单位元。这样，商群将原群划分为若干等价类，每个等价类对应一个陪集。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 多项式环</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[R_q = \mathbb{Z}_q[X]/(X^N + 1) = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(q, X^N + 1)
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>这是原始多项式环 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 的<strong>模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 版本</strong>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 为整数模数（通常是若干素数的乘积）。两种写法等价：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{写法} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
\mathbb{Z}_q[X]/(X^N + 1) &amp; \mathbb{Z}_q = \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z} \text{ 是模 } q \text{ 整数环（元素为 } \{0, 1, ..., q-1\}\text{），先对系数取模 } q\text{，再对多项式取模 } (X^N+1) \\
\mathbb{Z}[X]/(q, X^N + 1) &amp; \text{同时模去两个理想：系数模 } q\text{，且满足 } X^N \equiv -1
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(R_q\)</span> 中的元素是<strong>次数小于 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span>、系数在 <span class="math inline">\([0, q-1]\)</span> 范围内的多项式</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a_0 + a_1 X + \cdots + a_{N-1} X^{N-1}, \quad a_i \in \{0, 1, ..., q-1\}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>双重取模</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>系数层面</strong>：所有系数运算都在模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 下进行（即结果对 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 取余）</li>
<li><strong>多项式层面</strong>：满足 <span class="math inline">\(X^N \equiv -1\)</span>，高次项需降次</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>运算示例</strong>（设 <span class="math inline">\(N=4, q=17\)</span>）：</p>
<ul>
<li>系数模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(15X + 7X = 22X \equiv 5X \pmod{17}\)</span></li>
<li>乘法：<span class="math inline">\(3X^2 \cdot 5X^3 = 15X^5 = 15X \cdot X^4 \equiv -15X \equiv 2X \pmod{(17, X^4+1)}\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>在 CKKS 中的作用</strong>：密文多项式的系数都存储为模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 的整数，这是实现同态运算的基础。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 为整数模数，<span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 为 2 的幂次。</p>
<h4 id="213-中国剩余定理与环同构">2.1.3 中国剩余定理与环同构</h4>
<p><strong>引理 2.1</strong>（环同构）：设 <span class="math inline">\(N = 2^k\)</span> 为 2 的幂次，考虑多项式在复数域上的求值，存在以下环同构：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb{C}[X]/(X^N + 1) \cong \mathbb{C}^N
\]</div><p></p><p>即系数为复数的分圆多项式环同构于 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 个复数域的直积。同构映射由中国剩余定理（CRT）给出：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{CRT}: a(X) \mapsto (a(\zeta), a(\zeta^3), \ldots, a(\zeta^{2N-1})) \in \mathbb{C}^N
\]</div><p></p><p>这里 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta = e^{\pi i/N}\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 次本原单位根。</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(N = 2^k\)</span> 的条件至关重要。此时：</p>
<ol>
<li><span class="math inline">\(X^N + 1\)</span> 恰好是第 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 个分圆多项式 <span class="math inline">\(\Phi_{2N}(X)\)</span></li>
<li>模 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 的乘法群 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z}_{2N}^* = \{1, 3, 5, \ldots, 2N-1\}\)</span> 恰好包含所有奇数</li>
<li>因此 <span class="math inline">\(X^N + 1\)</span> 的根为 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta^j\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 取所有奇数）</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<p><strong>CRT 证明</strong>：下面我们从<strong>整数环</strong>出发，逐步推广到<strong>主理想整环（PID）</strong>，最后应用到<strong>多项式环</strong>，完整证明上述同构关系。</p>
<p><strong>第一步：整数环上的 CRT</strong></p>
<p><strong>定理（整数 CRT）</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(n_1, n_2, \ldots, n_k\)</span> 是两两互素的正整数，令 <span class="math inline">\(n = n_1 n_2 \cdots n_k\)</span>。则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \cong \mathbb{Z}/n_1\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/n_2\mathbb{Z} \times \cdots \times \mathbb{Z}/n_k\mathbb{Z}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>证明</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>构造同态</strong>：定义映射</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\phi: \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}/n_1\mathbb{Z} \times \cdots \times \mathbb{Z}/n_k\mathbb{Z}, \quad a \mapsto (a \bmod n_1, \ldots, a \bmod n_k)
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>
<p><strong>确定核（Kernel）</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\ker(\phi) = \{a \in \mathbb{Z} : n_i \mid a \text{ 对所有 } i\} = \{a \in \mathbb{Z} : n \mid a\} = n\mathbb{Z}
\]</div><p></p><p>（若 <span class="math inline">\(n_i\)</span> 两两互素，则 <span class="math inline">\(\text{lcm}(n_1,\ldots,n_k) = n_1\cdots n_k = n\)</span>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>证明满射（Surjective）</strong>：需证：对任意 <span class="math inline">\((a_1, \ldots, a_k)\)</span>，存在 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(a \equiv a_i \pmod{n_i}\)</span> 对所有 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>。</p>
<p>令 <span class="math inline">\(m_i = n / n_i = \prod_{j \neq i} n_j\)</span>。由两两互素，<span class="math inline">\(\gcd(m_i, n_i) = 1\)</span>。</p>
<p>因此存在 <span class="math inline">\(m_i^{-1} \bmod n_i\)</span>（乘法逆元）。构造：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a = \sum_{i=1}^k a_i \cdot m_i \cdot (m_i^{-1} \bmod n_i)
\]</div><p></p><p>验证：当 <span class="math inline">\(j \neq i\)</span> 时，<span class="math inline">\(n_j \mid m_i\)</span>，故 <span class="math inline">\(a \equiv a_i \cdot m_i \cdot m_i^{-1} \equiv a_i \pmod{n_i}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>应用同态基本定理</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} = \mathbb{Z}/\ker(\phi) \cong \text{Im}(\phi) = \prod_{i=1}^k \mathbb{Z}/n_i\mathbb{Z}
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ol>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>显式同构</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>正向</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(a \bmod n \mapsto (a \bmod n_1, \ldots, a \bmod n_k)\)</span></li>
<li><strong>逆向（CRT重构）</strong>：给定 <span class="math inline">\((a_1, \ldots, a_k)\)</span>，计算<p></p><div class="math display">\[a = \sum_{i=1}^k a_i \cdot m_i \cdot (m_i^{-1} \bmod n_i) \bmod n
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>第二步：推广到主理想整环（PID）</strong></p>
<p>在将CRT从整数环推广到多项式环之前，我们需要理解<strong>主理想整环（Principal Ideal Domain, PID）</strong>这一重要代数结构。</p>
<p><strong>定义（主理想整环）</strong>：一个整环 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 称为<strong>主理想整环</strong>，如果 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 的每个理想都是主理想，即对 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 的任意理想 <span class="math inline">\(I\)</span>，存在元素 <span class="math inline">\(a \in R\)</span> 使得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[I = (a) = \{r \cdot a : r \in R\}
\]</div><p></p><p>PID中的"理想"都可以由<strong>单个元素生成</strong>，就像整数环中所有偶数构成理想 <span class="math inline">\((2)\)</span>，由2生成。</p>
<p><strong>为什么整数环 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z}\)</span> 和多项式环 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]\)</span> 都是PID？</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{环} &amp; \text{理想的结构} &amp; \text{为何是PID} \\
\hline
\mathbb{Z} &amp; \text{所有理想形如 } n\mathbb{Z} = (n) &amp; \text{任意理想都是某个整数 } n \text{ 的所有倍数} \\
\mathbb{C}[X] &amp; \text{所有理想形如 } (f(X)) &amp; \text{多项式环是Euclidean整环，可用带余除法证明}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p>在PID中，任意两个元素 <span class="math inline">\(a, b\)</span> 都存在<strong>最大公因式</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\gcd(a,b)\)</span>，且满足<strong>Bézout恒等式</strong>：存在 <span class="math inline">\(u, v \in R\)</span> 使得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[u \cdot a + v \cdot b = \gcd(a,b)
\]</div><p></p><p>这正是CRT证明中构造逆元的关键工具！</p>
<p><strong>定理（PID 上的 CRT）</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 是PID，<span class="math inline">\(f_1, \ldots, f_k \in R\)</span> 两两互素（即 <span class="math inline">\(\gcd(f_i, f_j) = 1\)</span> 对 <span class="math inline">\(i \neq j\)</span>），令 <span class="math inline">\(f = f_1 f_2 \cdots f_k\)</span>。则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[R/(f) \cong R/(f_1) \times \cdots \times R/(f_k)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>证明</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>构造同态</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\phi: R \to R/(f_1) \times \cdots \times R/(f_k), \quad a \mapsto (a \bmod f_1, \ldots, a \bmod f_k)
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>
<p><strong>确定核</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\ker(\phi) = \{a \in R : f_i \mid a \text{ 对所有 } i\} = (f)
\]</div><p></p><p>因为 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 两两互素，所以 <span class="math inline">\(\text{lcm}(f_1,\ldots,f_k) = f_1 \cdots f_k = f\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>证明满射（关键步骤）</strong>：需找到 <span class="math inline">\(e_i \in R\)</span> 使得：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e_i \equiv 1 \pmod{f_i}\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e_i \equiv 0 \pmod{f_j}\)</span> 对 <span class="math inline">\(j \neq i\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>令 <span class="math inline">\(g_i = f / f_i = \prod_{j \neq i} f_j\)</span>。因 <span class="math inline">\(\gcd(f_i, f_j) = 1\)</span>，有 <span class="math inline">\(\gcd(g_i, f_i) = 1\)</span>。</p>
<p>在PID中，由<strong>Bézout恒等式</strong>，存在 <span class="math inline">\(u_i, v_i \in R\)</span> 使得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[u_i \cdot g_i + v_i \cdot f_i = 1
\]</div><p></p><p>取 <span class="math inline">\(e_i = u_i \cdot g_i\)</span>，则：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e_i \equiv 1 \pmod{f_i}\)</span>（因 <span class="math inline">\(e_i = 1 - v_i f_i\)</span>）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e_i \equiv 0 \pmod{f_j}\)</span> 对 <span class="math inline">\(j \neq i\)</span>（因 <span class="math inline">\(f_j \mid g_i\)</span>）</li>
</ul>
<p>对任意 <span class="math inline">\((a_1, \ldots, a_k)\)</span>，构造 <span class="math inline">\(a = \sum_{i=1}^k a_i \cdot e_i\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(a \equiv a_i \pmod{f_i}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>由同态基本定理得证</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[R/(f) \cong \prod_{i=1}^k R/(f_i)
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ol>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>第三步：应用到多项式环 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]\)</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>设定</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{C}[X]\)</span> 是PID（因 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}\)</span> 是域，<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]\)</span> 是Euclidean整环，从而是PID）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(X) = X^N + 1\)</span></li>
<li>在 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}\)</span> 上完全分解：<span class="math inline">\(f(X) = \prod_{j=0}^{N-1} (X - \zeta^{2j+1})\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta = e^{2\pi i / 2N}\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 次本原单位根</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>验证互素条件</strong>：对 <span class="math inline">\(i \neq j\)</span>，一次多项式 <span class="math inline">\((X - \zeta^{2i+1})\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\((X - \zeta^{2j+1})\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>都是首一的</li>
<li>根不同</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\gcd = 1\)</span>（两两互素）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>应用CRT</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb{C}[X]/(X^N+1) \cong \prod_{j=0}^{N-1} \mathbb{C}[X]/(X - \zeta^{2j+1})
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>第四步：简化每个分量</strong></p>
<p><strong>定理</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]/(X - \alpha) \cong \mathbb{C}\)</span></p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：定义<strong>求值映射</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{ev}_\alpha: \mathbb{C}[X] \to \mathbb{C}, \quad f(X) \mapsto f(\alpha)
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li><strong>满射</strong>：对任意 <span class="math inline">\(c \in \mathbb{C}\)</span>，常数多项式 <span class="math inline">\(f(X) = c\)</span> 满足 <span class="math inline">\(f(\alpha) = c\)</span></li>
<li><strong>核</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\ker(\text{ev}_\alpha) = \{f \in \mathbb{C}[X] : f(\alpha) = 0\} = (X - \alpha)\)</span>（因 <span class="math inline">\(X-\alpha\)</span> 不可约）</li>
</ul>
<p>由同态基本定理：<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]/(X-\alpha) \cong \mathbb{C}\)</span></p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p>在模 <span class="math inline">\((X - \alpha)\)</span> 下，<span class="math inline">\(X \equiv \alpha\)</span>，所以任何多项式 <span class="math inline">\(f(X)\)</span> 都等价于常数 <span class="math inline">\(f(\alpha)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>第五步：综合结果</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\boxed{\mathbb{C}[X]/(X^N + 1) \cong \mathbb{C}^N}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>显式同构</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>正向（NTT）</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(f(X) \mapsto (f(\zeta), f(\zeta^3), \ldots, f(\zeta^{2N-1}))\)</span></li>
<li><strong>逆向（INTT）</strong>：<span class="math inline">\((z_0, \ldots, z_{N-1}) \mapsto \sum_{j=0}^{N-1} z_j \cdot e_j(X)\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(e_j\)</span> 是Lagrange基多项式(逆向本质上是在做多项式插值)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>总结表</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{步骤} &amp; \text{核心思想} \\
\hline
\text{整数CRT} &amp; \text{利用 } \gcd(m_i, n_i) = 1 \text{ 构造逆元，证明满射} \\
\text{PID推广} &amp; \text{Bézout恒等式保证逆元存在，互素条件保证可分解} \\
\text{多项式应用} &amp; \text{一次因式互素 } \Rightarrow \text{ 分量为 } \mathbb{C} \\
\text{NTT根源} &amp; \text{求值映射 = CRT同构的具体实现}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>符号说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N + 1)\)</span> 是前面定义的<strong>原始多项式环</strong>（次数 <span class="math inline">\(&lt; N\)</span> 的整系数多项式）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{C}[X]/(X^N + 1)\)</span>：系数为复数的多项式环，模 <span class="math inline">\((X^N + 1)\)</span>。从代数角度，这与 <span class="math inline">\(R \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{C}\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 与复数域在 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z}\)</span> 上的张量积）<strong>同构</strong></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z}_{2N}^*\)</span>：模 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 的<strong>乘法群</strong>（与 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 互素的剩余类），由于 <span class="math inline">\(N=2^d\)</span>，互素的数即为<strong>奇数</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>环同态的性质</strong>：映射 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma: a(X) \mapsto (a(\zeta), a(\zeta^3), \ldots, a(\zeta^{2N-1}))\)</span> 保持环运算：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>加法</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\sigma(a + b) = \sigma(a) + \sigma(b)\)</span>（分量相加）</li>
<li><strong>乘法</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\sigma(a \cdot b) = \sigma(a) \odot \sigma(b)\)</span>（分量相乘，Hadamard积）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>实例</strong>（设 <span class="math inline">\(N=4\)</span>）：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\zeta = e^{\pi i/4} = \frac{1+i}{\sqrt{2}}\)</span>（8次本原单位根）</li>
<li>根为 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta^1, \zeta^3, \zeta^5, \zeta^7\)</span>（即 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta, i\zeta, -\zeta, -i\zeta\)</span>）</li>
<li>多项式 <span class="math inline">\(a(X) = 1 + 2X + 3X^2 + 4X^3\)</span> 映射为向量：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sigma(a) = (a(\zeta), a(\zeta^3), a(\zeta^5), a(\zeta^7)) \in \mathbb{C}^4
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="22-格密码学基础">2.2 格密码学基础</h3>
<h4 id="221-格的定义">2.2.1 格的定义</h4>
<p><strong>定义 2.1</strong>（格）：设 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{b}_1, \ldots, \mathbf{b}_n \in \mathbb{R}^m\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个线性无关的向量，由它们生成的格定义为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathcal{L} = \left\{ \sum_{i=1}^n z_i \mathbf{b}_i : z_i \in \mathbb{Z} \right\}
\]</div><p></p><p>在 CKKS 中，我们使用的是一种特殊的格——<strong>理想格</strong>（Ideal Lattice），它具有额外的代数结构。</p>
<p><strong>定义 2.2</strong>（理想格）：设 <span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N + 1)\)</span> 为分圆多项式环，<span class="math inline">\(I \subseteq R\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 的一个理想。通过<strong>系数嵌入</strong>（coefficient embedding），将多项式 <span class="math inline">\(a(X) = a_0 + a_1 X + \cdots + a_{N-1} X^{N-1} \in R\)</span> 映射为整数向量 <span class="math inline">\((a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{N-1}) \in \mathbb{Z}^N\)</span>。</p>
<p>理想格是指由理想 <span class="math inline">\(I\)</span> 的系数嵌入生成的格：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathcal{L}(I) = \left\{ (a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{N-1}) \in \mathbb{Z}^N : a(X) = \sum_{i=0}^{N-1} a_i X^i \in I \right\}
\]</div><p></p><p>理想格具有以下性质：代数结构（不仅是加法群，还保持多项式乘法结构）、循环性（由于 <span class="math inline">\(X^N \equiv -1\)</span>，格具有特定的对称性）、效率优势（基于理想格的运算可用 NTT 加速，比普通格快 <span class="math inline">\(O(N)\)</span> 倍）。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>一般格中的向量是任意的，而理想格中的向量必须对应某个理想中的多项式。例如，若 <span class="math inline">\(f(X) \in I\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(X \cdot f(X) \in I\)</span> 也必须在格中，这给格带来了额外的约束和结构。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="222-环面学习问题rlwe">2.2.2 环面学习问题（RLWE）</h4>
<p>CKKS 的安全性基于 <strong>Ring Learning With Errors (RLWE)</strong> 问题。</p>
<p><strong>定义 2.3</strong>（RLWE 分布）：设安全参数为 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span>（2 的幂次）和模数 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span>。定义：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>多项式环</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N + 1)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(R_q = \mathbb{Z}_q[X]/(X^N + 1)\)</span></li>
<li><strong>误差分布</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(\chi\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 上的概率分布（通常为离散高斯分布 <span class="math inline">\(D_{R, \sigma}\)</span>，标准差 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma\)</span> 较小）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>多项式环 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 中的元素是 <span class="math inline">\(N-1\)</span> 次整系数多项式 <span class="math inline">\(a(X) = a_0 + a_1 X + \cdots + a_{N-1} X^{N-1}\)</span>。</p>
<p>"<span class="math inline">\(\chi\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 上的概率分布"意味着：<strong>从 <span class="math inline">\(R\)</span> 中按某种规则随机选取多项式</strong>。具体采样方式为：</p>
<ol>
<li>对每个系数位置 <span class="math inline">\(i = 0, 1, \ldots, N-1\)</span>，独立地从<strong>一维离散高斯分布</strong> <span class="math inline">\(D_{\mathbb{Z}, \sigma}\)</span> 采样整数 <span class="math inline">\(e_i\)</span></li>
<li>组合成多项式：<span class="math inline">\(e(X) = e_0 + e_1 X + \cdots + e_{N-1} X^{N-1}\)</span></li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<p>RLWE 分布 <span class="math inline">\(D_{\text{RLWE}}\)</span> 由以下方式生成：</p>
<ul>
<li>均匀随机选取 <span class="math inline">\(a \leftarrow R_q\)</span></li>
<li>均匀随机选取密钥 <span class="math inline">\(s \leftarrow R\)</span></li>
<li>从误差分布采样 <span class="math inline">\(e \leftarrow \chi\)</span></li>
<li>输出样本 <span class="math inline">\((a, b) \in R_q^2\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(b = a \cdot s + e \mod q\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>定义 2.4</strong>（决策性 RLWE 问题）：给定 <span class="math inline">\((a, b) \in R_q^2\)</span>，区分以下两种情况：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>情况 1（RLWE 样本）</strong>：<span class="math inline">\((a, b)\)</span> 按 RLWE 分布生成，即 <span class="math inline">\(a \leftarrow R_q\)</span> 均匀随机，<span class="math inline">\(b = a \cdot s + e \mod q\)</span></li>
<li><strong>情况 2（均匀随机）</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(a, b\)</span> 均独立均匀随机从 <span class="math inline">\(R_q\)</span> 中选取</li>
</ul>
<p>攻击者的目标是判断给定的 <span class="math inline">\((a, b)\)</span> 属于哪种情况。</p>
<p><strong>定义 2.5</strong>（最短向量问题）：设 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{L}\)</span> 是一个格，定义：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>最短向量问题（SVP）</strong>：找到格中长度最短的非零向量，即找到 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{v} \in \mathcal{L} \setminus \{\mathbf{0}\}\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(\|\mathbf{v}\|\)</span> 最小</li>
<li><strong>近似最短向量问题（Approximate SVP，<span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>-SVP）</strong>：找到非零向量 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{v} \in \mathcal{L}\)</span>，使得 <span class="math inline">\(\|\mathbf{v}\| \leq \gamma \cdot \lambda_1(\mathcal{L})\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(\lambda_1(\mathcal{L})\)</span> 是最短向量的长度，<span class="math inline">\(\gamma \geq 1\)</span> 是近似因子</li>
</ul>
<p>对于<strong>理想格</strong>，相应地定义 <strong>Ideal-SVP</strong> 和 <strong><span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>-Ideal-SVP</strong>。</p>
<p><strong>定理 2.1</strong>（安全性归约）：对于适当选择的参数，如果存在一个算法能在多项式时间内解决 RLWE 问题，那么存在一个算法能在多项式时间内解决 <span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>-Ideal-SVP（对于某个近似因子 <span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>）。即：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{RLWE} \leq_P \gamma\text{-Ideal-SVP}
\]</div><p></p><p>这意味着 <strong>RLWE 问题的困难性至少与 Ideal-SVP 相当</strong>。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：此归约证明涉及复杂的格归约技术，超出本文范围，详见相关密码学文献。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<h3 id="23-复数编码理论">2.3 复数编码理论</h3>
<p>CKKS 的核心是将复数向量编码为多项式，这是实现 SIMD 风格并行计算的关键。</p>
<h4 id="231-规范嵌入">2.3.1 规范嵌入</h4>
<p><strong>定义 2.6</strong>（规范嵌入）：定义映射 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma: R \to \mathbb{C}^N\)</span> 为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sigma: a(X) \mapsto (a(\zeta), a(\zeta^3), \ldots, a(\zeta^{2N-1}))
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta^j\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 为奇数）是 <span class="math inline">\(X^N + 1\)</span> 的所有根。</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意：规范嵌入 vs. CKKS 编码</strong></p>
<p>规范嵌入 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma: R \to \mathbb{C}^N\)</span> 的方向是<strong>多项式 → 复数向量</strong>。</p>
<p>但 <strong>CKKS 的编码（Encode）使用的是 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma^{-1}\)</span></strong>，方向是<strong>复数向量 → 多项式</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Encode}: \mathbf{z} \in \mathbb{C}^{N/2} \xrightarrow{\text{扩展+缩放}} \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}} \in \mathbb{C}^N \xrightarrow{\sigma^{-1}} m(X) \in R
\]</div><p></p><p>因此：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>规范嵌入</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\sigma\)</span>：用于理论分析和解码（Decode）</li>
<li><strong>CKKS 编码</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\sigma^{-1}\)</span>：用于加密前的数据准备</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>性质 2.1</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\sigma\)</span> 是环同态（保持加法和乘法）</li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(a, b \in R\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(\sigma(a \cdot b) = \sigma(a) \odot \sigma(b)\)</span>（分量乘法）</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="232-解码空间">2.3.2 解码空间</h4>
<p>定义 <strong>明文空间</strong> 为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathcal{S} = \mathbb{C}^{N/2}
\]</div><p></p><p>注意：由于 <span class="math inline">\(a(X) \in \mathbb{R}[X]/(X^N+1)\)</span> 时 <span class="math inline">\(a(\zeta^{2N-j}) = \overline{a(\zeta^j)}\)</span>，所以我们只有 <span class="math inline">\(N/2\)</span> 个复数槽位。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="ckks-方案概览">CKKS 方案概览</h2>
<h3 id="31-核心思想">3.1 核心思想</h3>
<p>CKKS 方案的核心思想可以用以下图示表示：</p>
<pre><code>复数向量 z ∈ ℂ^(N/2)      【待加密数据】
        ↓ 编码 (σ⁻¹)
多项式 m(X) ∈ R           【SIMD: N/2个槽位打包到一个多项式】
        ↓ 加密
密文 ct = (c₀, c₁) ∈ R_q² 【含噪声的加密容器】
        ↓ 同态运算 (⊕, ⊗)
结果密文 ct'               【密文上完成批量计算】
        ↓ 解密
近似多项式 m̃(X)            【含误差，可控】
        ↓ 解码 (σ)
结果向量 z' ∈ ℂ^(N/2)     【z'_j ≈ f(z_j)】
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ol>
<li><strong>编码 ≠ 加密</strong>：编码是确定性的插值转换（无密钥）；加密才是带噪声的同态加密</li>
<li><strong>为什么编码？</strong> CKKS 只能加密多项式，不能直接加密复数向量</li>
<li><strong>SIMD 优势</strong>：一次加密处理 <span class="math inline">\(N/2\)</span> 个复数，同态运算自动并行作用于所有槽位</li>
<li><strong>近似性</strong>：解密后是近似值，误差可通过增大缩放因子 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 控制</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="32-参数设置">3.2 参数设置</h3>
<p>CKKS 方案由以下参数完全确定：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{参数} &amp; \text{符号} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
\text{多项式次数} &amp; N = 2^d &amp; \text{决定 SIMD 槽数，槽数 } = N/2 \\
\text{密文模数} &amp; Q = q_L \cdot q_{L-1} \cdots q_0 &amp; \text{层级模数链} \\
\text{层级数} &amp; L &amp; \text{最大乘法深度} \\
\text{误差分布} &amp; \chi &amp; \text{通常为 } D_{\mathbb{Z}^N, \sigma} \\
\text{缩放因子} &amp; \Delta &amp; \text{控制精度，通常为 } 2^p
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="321-安全性级别">3.2.1 安全性级别</h4>
<p>根据同态加密标准（Homomorphic Encryption Standard）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
\text{安全级别} &amp; \text{128-bit} &amp; \text{192-bit} &amp; \text{256-bit} \\
\hline
\text{最小 } \log_2(N) &amp; 12 &amp; 13 &amp; 14 \\
\text{最小 } \log_2(Q) &amp; 109 &amp; 218 &amp; 438
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="322-误差分布">3.2.2 误差分布</h4>
<p>通常使用离散高斯分布 <span class="math inline">\(D_{\mathbb{Z}^N, \sigma}\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>标准差 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma \approx 3.2\)</span></li>
<li>密钥分布：稀疏分布（HWHM = Hamming Weight Half Minimum）</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="323-参数选择原则">3.2.3 参数选择原则</h4>
<p><strong>安全性约束</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span> 的选择必须满足安全性要求（见上表）</li>
<li>更大的 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span> 允许更深的计算，但需要更大的 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 来保持安全性</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>精度与效率权衡</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{缩放因子 } \Delta &amp; \text{精度} &amp; \text{乘法深度} \\
\hline
2^{20} &amp; \sim 6 \text{ 位小数} &amp; \text{较大} \\
2^{30} &amp; \sim 9 \text{ 位小数} &amp; \text{中等} \\
2^{40} &amp; \sim 12 \text{ 位小数} &amp; \text{较小}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>性能基准</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(N = 2^{14} = 16384\)</span>，128-bit 安全性）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作} &amp; \text{时间（单线程）} &amp; \text{吞吐量} \\
\hline
\text{加密} &amp; \sim 1 \text{ ms} &amp; 16K \text{ 个槽} \\
\text{解密} &amp; \sim 0.5 \text{ ms} &amp; 16K \text{ 个槽} \\
\text{加法} &amp; \sim 0.01 \text{ ms} &amp; 16K \text{ 个槽} \\
\text{乘法} &amp; \sim 10 \text{ ms} &amp; 16K \text{ 个槽} \\
\text{旋转} &amp; \sim 5 \text{ ms} &amp; 16K \text{ 个槽}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="33-关键特性">3.3 关键特性</h3>
<h4 id="近似算术">近似算术</h4>
<p>CKKS 是一种 <strong>近似同态加密</strong>（Approximate Homomorphic Encryption）方案。解密结果包含小误差：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Decrypt}(\text{Encrypt}(m)) \approx m
\]</div><p></p><p>误差满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|m - \tilde{m}\|_\infty \leq \epsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(\epsilon\)</span> 可通过参数选择控制在可接受范围内。</p>
<h4 id="simd-批处理">SIMD 批处理</h4>
<p>单次加密可处理 <span class="math inline">\(N/2\)</span> 个复数，支持：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>分量加法</strong>：<span class="math inline">\((a_1, \ldots, a_n) + (b_1, \ldots, b_n) = (a_1+b_1, \ldots, a_n+b_n)\)</span></li>
<li><strong>分量乘法</strong>：<span class="math inline">\((a_1, \ldots, a_n) \odot (b_1, \ldots, b_n) = (a_1 b_1, \ldots, a_n b_n)\)</span></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="核心构造">核心构造</h2>
<h3 id="41-密钥生成">4.1 密钥生成</h3>
<h4 id="411-密钥生成算法">4.1.1 密钥生成算法</h4>
<p><strong>符号说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\lambda\)</span>：安全参数（如 128-bit、256-bit 安全级别）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\chi_{\text{key}}\)</span>：<strong>密钥分布</strong>，通常采用 HWHM（Hamming Weight Half Minimum）分布，即从 <span class="math inline">\(\{0, \pm 1\}^N\)</span> 中选取固定汉明重量（非零元数量）的稀疏多项式</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(Q = q_L \cdot q_{L-1} \cdots q_0\)</span>：顶层模数（所有层级模数的乘积）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>CKKS.KeyGen</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(1^\lambda\)</span>):</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>私钥（Secret Key）</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[sk = s \leftarrow \chi_{\text{key}}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 是小系数多项式（稀疏且系数在 <span class="math inline">\(\{-1, 0, 1\}\)</span>），只有持有 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 才能正确解密。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>公共密钥（Public Key）</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a \leftarrow R_Q \text{ (均匀随机)}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[e \leftarrow \chi_{\text{err}} \text{ (误差分布，小系数)}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[b = -a \cdot s + e \in R_Q, \quad pk = (b, a) \in R_Q^2
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p><strong>设计原理</strong>：这实际上是 RLWE 样本 <span class="math inline">\((a, b)\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(b = -a \cdot s + e\)</span>。这种构造使得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[b + a \cdot s = e
\]</div><p></p><p>右侧是小误差（不是精确为 0，但很小），这是解密的关键等式。</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="412-密钥性质">4.1.2 密钥性质</h4>
<h3 id="42-编码encoding">4.2 编码（Encoding）</h3>
<p>编码是将复数向量转换为多项式的过程。</p>
<h4 id="421-编码算法">4.2.1 编码算法</h4>
<p><strong>输入</strong>：复数向量 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{z} = (z_0, z_1, \ldots, z_{N/2-1}) \in \mathbb{C}^{N/2}\)</span></p>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：多项式 <span class="math inline">\(m(X) \in R\)</span></p>
<p><strong>算法步骤</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>扩展为完整向量</strong>：由于共轭对称性，构造</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{z}_{\text{full}} = (z_0, z_1, \ldots, z_{N/2-1}, \overline{z_{N/2-1}}, \ldots, \overline{z_1}, \overline{z_0}) \in \mathbb{C}^N
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>
<p><strong>缩放</strong>：乘以缩放因子 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>（通常为 <span class="math inline">\(2^p\)</span>，如 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta = 2^{30}\)</span>）</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{v} = \Delta \cdot \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p><strong>为什么需要缩放？</strong> 后续要进行舍入，缩放可以减小舍入带来的精度损失。<span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 越大，精度越高，但可计算的乘法深度越小。</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>逆规范嵌入（插值）</strong>：求解多项式 <span class="math inline">\(m'(X) \in \mathbb{C}[X]\)</span> 使得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[m'(\zeta^{2j+1}) = v_j, \quad j = 0, 1, \ldots, N-1
\]</div><p></p><p>这等价于计算 <span class="math inline">\(m'(X) = \sigma^{-1}(\mathbf{v})\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma^{-1}\)</span> 是规范嵌入的逆映射（可通过 Lagrange 插值实现）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>舍入到整数系数</strong>：由于明文空间是 <span class="math inline">\(R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N+1)\)</span>（整数系数多项式），需要将 <span class="math inline">\(m'(X)\)</span> 的系数舍入到最近整数：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[m(X) = \left\lfloor m'(X) \right\rceil = \left\lfloor \sigma^{-1}(\Delta \cdot \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}}) \right\rceil \in R
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ol>
<h4 id="422-编码的数学表示">4.2.2 编码的数学表示</h4>
<p><strong>定理 4.1</strong>（编码的正确性）：设 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{z} \in \mathbb{C}^{N/2}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(m = \text{Encode}(\mathbf{z})\)</span> 是编码得到的多项式。对 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 进行解码（规范嵌入并除以 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>）得到：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{\sigma(m)}{\Delta} = \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}} + \frac{\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{round}}}{\Delta}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中舍入误差满足 <span class="math inline">\(\|\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{round}}\|_\infty \leq \frac{1}{2}\)</span>。因此解码后的相对误差不超过 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{1}{2\Delta}\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：由编码算法，<span class="math inline">\(m(X) = \lfloor \sigma^{-1}(\Delta \cdot \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}}) \rceil\)</span>。设 <span class="math inline">\(m'(X) = \sigma^{-1}(\Delta \cdot \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}})\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(m = m' + \epsilon_{\text{round}}\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(\|\epsilon_{\text{round}}\|_\infty \leq \frac{1}{2}\)</span>。因此 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma(m) = \Delta \cdot \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}} + \sigma(\epsilon_{\text{round}})\)</span>，除以 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 即得结论。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<h4 id="423-编码示例">4.2.3 编码示例</h4>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(N = 4\)</span>（即 2 个复数槽），要编码 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{z} = (1+2i, 3-4i)\)</span>：</p>
<ol>
<li>计算单位根：<span class="math inline">\(\zeta = e^{\pi i/4}\)</span></li>
<li>扩展向量：<span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{z}_{\text{full}} = (1+2i, 3-4i, 3+4i, 1-2i)\)</span></li>
<li>求解插值多项式（设 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta = 100\)</span>）</li>
<li>得到 <span class="math inline">\(m(X) \approx 100 \cdot \sigma^{-1}(\mathbf{z}_{\text{full}})\)</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 id="43-解码decoding">4.3 解码（Decoding）</h3>
<p>解码是编码的逆过程，从多项式还原为复数向量。</p>
<p><strong>算法</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>规范嵌入（求值）</strong>：计算多项式 <span class="math inline">\(m(X)\)</span> 在所有 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 个根处的取值</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{w} = \sigma(m) = (m(\zeta), m(\zeta^3), \ldots, m(\zeta^{2N-1})) \in \mathbb{C}^N
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>
<p><strong>去除缩放</strong>：除以缩放因子 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{w}' = \mathbf{w} / \Delta
\]</div><p></p><p>此时 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{w}' \approx \mathbf{z}_{\text{full}}\)</span>，即编码时构造的完整向量（含共轭对称部分）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>提取有效分量</strong>：由于共轭对称性 <span class="math inline">\(w'_{N-1-j} = \overline{w'_j}\)</span>，只需取前 <span class="math inline">\(N/2\)</span> 个分量：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{z} = (w'_0, w'_1, \ldots, w'_{N/2-1}) \in \mathbb{C}^{N/2}
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>误差分析</strong>：</p>
<p>解码结果包含两部分误差：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>舍入误差</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{round}}\)</span>：编码时系数舍入引入（与 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 成反比）</li>
<li><strong>加密噪声</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{noise}}\)</span>：同态加密和解密过程中的噪声累积</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{z}_{\text{decoded}} = \mathbf{z}_{\text{original}} + \underbrace{\frac{\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{round}}}{\Delta}}_{\text{编码误差}} + \underbrace{\frac{\mathbf{\epsilon}_{\text{noise}}}{\Delta}}_{\text{加密噪声}}
\]</div><p></p><p>选择足够大的 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 可使两项误差都任意小。</p>
<h3 id="44-加密">4.4 加密</h3>
<h4 id="441-加密算法">4.4.1 加密算法</h4>
<p><strong>设计目标</strong>：构造密文 <span class="math inline">\((c_0, c_1)\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s \approx m \pmod{Q}\)</span>，即解密时能得到明文加上小噪声。</p>
<p><strong>CKKS.Encrypt</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(pk = (b, a)\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(m \in R\)</span>):</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>采样随机掩码</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(v \leftarrow \chi_{\text{enc}}\)</span>：加密随机数（类似一次性密钥）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e_0, e_1 \leftarrow \chi_{\text{err}}\)</span>：加密噪声（小系数多项式）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>构造密文</strong>：利用公钥 "包装" 明文</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0 = b \cdot v + e_0 + m \pmod{Q}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[c_1 = a \cdot v + e_1 \pmod{Q}
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(ct = (c_0, c_1) \in R_Q^2\)</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p>密文本质上是 RLWE 样本的"变形"。<span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 是"盲化因子"，确保同一明文每次加密结果不同（语义安全）；<span class="math inline">\(e_0, e_1\)</span> 是新加入的加密噪声。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="442-安全性基础">4.4.2 安全性基础</h4>
<p>加密的安全性基于 <strong>RLWE 假设</strong>（定义 2.3）：区分 <span class="math inline">\((a, a \cdot s + e)\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\((a, u)\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 均匀随机）是困难的。</p>
<p><strong>密文的安全性分析</strong>：</p>
<p>密文 <span class="math inline">\((c_0, c_1)\)</span> 的第二分量 <span class="math inline">\(c_1 = a \cdot v + e_1\)</span> 具有 RLWE 样本的形式（其中 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 作为"临时密钥"）。由 RLWE 假设，<span class="math inline">\(c_1\)</span> 与均匀随机不可区分。</p>
<p>第一分量 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 = b \cdot v + e_0 + m = (-a \cdot s + e) \cdot v + e_0 + m\)</span>。在 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的随机性掩盖下，<span class="math inline">\(c_0\)</span> 也与随机元素不可区分（即使给定 <span class="math inline">\(c_1\)</span>）。</p>
<p>因此密文 <span class="math inline">\((c_0, c_1)\)</span> 与均匀随机对不可区分，满足 <strong>IND-CPA 安全</strong>。</p>
<h3 id="45-解密">4.5 解密</h3>
<h4 id="451-解密算法">4.5.1 解密算法</h4>
<p><strong>CKKS.Decrypt</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(sk = s\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(ct = (c_0, c_1)\)</span>):</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\tilde{m} = c_0 + c_1 \cdot s \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 是当前层级的模数（初始时 <span class="math inline">\(q = Q\)</span>，经过重缩放后 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 会减小）。</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>为什么是近似？</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = m + e_{\text{total}}
\]</div><p></p><p>结果不是精确的 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span>，而是 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 加上噪声。CKKS 是<strong>近似加密</strong>，解密结果是近似的。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="452-解密原理">4.5.2 解密原理</h4>
<p><strong>核心等式</strong>：对于合法生成的公钥 <span class="math inline">\((b, a)\)</span> 和私钥 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>，密钥生成保证了：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[b + a \cdot s = e \pmod{Q}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(e\)</span> 是小噪声（系数绝对值通常 <span class="math inline">\(&lt; 6\sigma\)</span>）。这个等式是解密的基础。</p>
<p><strong>为什么加密构造能解密？</strong> 对密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct = (c_0, c_1)\)</span> 计算 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
c_0 + c_1 \cdot s 
&amp;= (b \cdot v + e_0 + m) + (a \cdot v + e_1) \cdot s \\
&amp;= m + (b + a \cdot s) \cdot v + e_0 + e_1 \cdot s \\
&amp;= m + e \cdot v + e_0 + e_1 \cdot s \quad \text{（利用 } b + a \cdot s = e \text{）}
\\
&amp;= m + e_{\text{enc}}
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>解密误差</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[e_{\text{enc}} = e \cdot v + e_0 + e_1 \cdot s
\]</div><p></p><p>虽然看起来复杂，但 <span class="math inline">\(e, v, e_0, e_1, s\)</span> 都是<strong>小系数多项式</strong>，乘积和求和后仍保持较小（相对于模数 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span>）。</p>
<h4 id="453-解密分析与误差来源">4.5.3 解密分析与误差来源</h4>
<p><strong>定理 4.2</strong>（解密近似性）：设 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 加密明文 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 且当前层级模数为 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span>，则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Decrypt}(sk, ct) = m + e_{\text{total}} \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>总误差</strong> <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{total}}\)</span> 包含三部分：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{误差来源} &amp; \text{产生时机} &amp; \text{特点} \\
\hline
\text{初始加密误差 } e_{\text{enc}} &amp; \text{加密时} &amp; e \cdot v + e_0 + e_1 \cdot s\text{，初始较小} \\
\text{同态运算累积误差} &amp; \text{加法/乘法时} &amp; \text{加法线性增长，乘法平方增长} \\
\text{模数切换误差} &amp; \text{重缩放时} &amp; \text{除以 } q^* \text{ 引入的舍入误差，通常很小}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p>只要 <span class="math inline">\(\|e_{\text{total}}\|_\infty &lt; q/(2\Delta)\)</span>，解码后就能得到正确的明文（因为 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma^{-1}\)</span> 涉及除以 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>）。这就是 CKKS 需要<strong>重缩放</strong>的原因：控制噪声增长，保持噪声在可接受范围内。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="同态运算">同态运算</h2>
<h3 id="51-同态加法">5.1 同态加法</h3>
<h4 id="511-加法算法">5.1.1 加法算法</h4>
<p><strong>CKKS.Add</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(ct_1\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(ct_2\)</span>) —— <strong>同态加法算法</strong></p>
<p>给定加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_1\)</span> 的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct_1 = (c_0^{(1)}, c_1^{(1)})\)</span> 和加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_2\)</span> 的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct_2 = (c_0^{(2)}, c_1^{(2)})\)</span>，计算加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_1 + m_2\)</span> 的新密文。</p>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{add}} = (c_0^{\text{add}}, c_1^{\text{add}})\)</span></p>
<p><strong>运算</strong>：对应分量相加</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0^{\text{add}} = c_0^{(1)} + c_0^{(2)} \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[c_1^{\text{add}} = c_1^{(1)} + c_1^{(2)} \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="512-正确性">5.1.2 正确性</h4>
<p><strong>定理 5.1</strong>（加法正确性）：若 <span class="math inline">\(ct_1\)</span> 加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_1\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(ct_2\)</span> 加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_2\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{add}}\)</span> 加密 <span class="math inline">\(m_1 + m_2\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(ct_i\)</span> 解密得到 <span class="math inline">\(\tilde{m}_i = c_0^{(i)} + c_1^{(i)} \cdot s = m_i + e_i\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(i=1,2\)</span>），其中 <span class="math inline">\(m_i\)</span> 是明文多项式，<span class="math inline">\(e_i\)</span> 是噪声。</p>
<p>计算 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{add}}\)</span> 的解密：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
c_0^{\text{add}} + c_1^{\text{add}} \cdot s 
&amp;= (c_0^{(1)} + c_0^{(2)}) + (c_1^{(1)} + c_1^{(2)}) \cdot s \\
&amp;= (c_0^{(1)} + c_1^{(1)} \cdot s) + (c_0^{(2)} + c_1^{(2)} \cdot s) \\
&amp;= \tilde{m}_1 + \tilde{m}_2 \\
&amp;= (m_1 + e_1) + (m_2 + e_2) \\
&amp;= (m_1 + m_2) + (e_1 + e_2)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{add}}\)</span> 解密后得到 <span class="math inline">\((m_1 + m_2) + (e_1 + e_2)\)</span>，即明文和 <span class="math inline">\(m_1 + m_2\)</span> 加上累积噪声。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<h4 id="513-误差增长">5.1.3 误差增长</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|e_{\text{add}}\| \leq \|e_1\| + \|e_2\|
\]</div><p></p><p>加法使误差线性增长。</p>
<h3 id="52-同态乘法">5.2 同态乘法</h3>
<h4 id="521-朴素乘法">5.2.1 朴素乘法</h4>
<p>对于密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct_1 = (c_0^{(1)}, c_1^{(1)})\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(ct_2 = (c_0^{(2)}, c_1^{(2)})\)</span>，计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_0 = c_0^{(1)} \cdot c_0^{(2)}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[d_1 = c_0^{(1)} \cdot c_1^{(2)} + c_1^{(1)} \cdot c_0^{(2)}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[d_2 = c_1^{(1)} \cdot c_1^{(2)}
\]</div><p></p><p>则有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(c_0^{(1)} + c_1^{(1)} s)(c_0^{(2)} + c_1^{(2)} s) = d_0 + d_1 s + d_2 s^2
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="522-重线性化relinearization">5.2.2 重线性化（Relinearization）</h4>
<p><strong>问题</strong>：乘法后密文变为三元组 <span class="math inline">\((d_0, d_1, d_2)\)</span>，解密需要 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_0 + d_1 \cdot s + d_2 \cdot s^2
\]</div><p></p><p>这会导致密文维度持续增长，需要转换回标准形式 <span class="math inline">\((c_0', c_1')\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>核心思想</strong>：</p>
<p>乘法后解密需要 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span>，但我们希望保持只用 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 就能解密（否则密钥会越来越大）。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(evk\)</span> 的作用就是<strong>"代替" <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span> 的工作</strong>——它里面偷偷包含了 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span> 的信息，通过数学技巧可以把 <span class="math inline">\(d_2 \cdot s^2\)</span> 转换成只需要 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 的形式。</p>
<p><strong>评估密钥 <span class="math inline">\(evk\)</span> 的组成</strong>：</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(evk = (b', a')\)</span> 是在密钥生成阶段生成的辅助密钥，其中：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(a' \leftarrow R_{Q^2}\)</span>：均匀随机选取的多项式</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(e' \leftarrow \chi_{\text{err}}\)</span>：小噪声</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(b' = -a' \cdot s + e' + Q \cdot s^2 \in R_{Q^2}\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>计算 <span class="math inline">\(b' + a' \cdot s\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[b' + a' \cdot s = e' + Q \cdot s^2 \approx Q \cdot s^2
\]</div><p></p><p>右边约等于 <span class="math inline">\(Q \cdot s^2\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span> 很小可忽略）。这意味着 <span class="math inline">\(evk\)</span> 把 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span> "放大"了 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span> 倍存储，后续可以通过除以 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span> 把 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span> 提取出来。</p>
<p><strong>CKKS.Relinearize</strong>(<span class="math inline">\((d_0, d_1, d_2)\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(evk = (b', a')\)</span>):</p>
<ol>
<li>将 <span class="math inline">\(d_2\)</span> 从模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 提升到模 <span class="math inline">\(Q^2\)</span>（零填充或适当扩展）</li>
<li>计算（在模 <span class="math inline">\(Q^2\)</span> 下进行，然后舍入回模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span>）：<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0' = d_0 + \left\lfloor \frac{d_2 \cdot b'}{Q} \right\rceil \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[c_1' = d_1 + \left\lfloor \frac{d_2 \cdot a'}{Q} \right\rceil \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>正确性验证</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
c_0' + c_1' \cdot s 
&amp;\approx d_0 + \frac{d_2 \cdot b'}{Q} + \left(d_1 + \frac{d_2 \cdot a'}{Q}\right) \cdot s \\
&amp;= d_0 + d_1 \cdot s + \frac{d_2 \cdot (b' + a' \cdot s)}{Q} \\
&amp;\approx d_0 + d_1 \cdot s + \frac{d_2 \cdot Q \cdot s^2}{Q} \\
&amp;= d_0 + d_1 \cdot s + d_2 \cdot s^2
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>完美！新的 <span class="math inline">\((c_0', c_1')\)</span> 解密后得到与原三元组相同的结果，但只需要 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>（不需要 <span class="math inline">\(s^2\)</span>）。</p>
<p><strong>为什么需要 <span class="math inline">\(Q \cdot s^2\)</span> 和模 <span class="math inline">\(Q^2\)</span>？</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{设计} &amp; \text{作用} \\
\hline
\text{模数 } Q^2 &amp; \text{提供足够空间，使得 } Q \cdot s^2 \text{ 不会溢出} \\
Q \cdot s^2 \text{ 项} &amp; \text{让 } b' + a's \approx Qs^2\text{，除以 } Q \text{ 后恰好得到 } s^2 \\
\text{除以 } Q \text{ 并舍入} &amp; \text{将结果从模 } Q^2 \text{ 映射回模 } Q\text{，同时提取 } s^2
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p>这种构造叫做 <strong>"密钥切换"（Key Switching）</strong> 技术。</p>
<p><strong>重线性化的误差分析</strong>：</p>
<p>上述推导中使用了近似 <span class="math inline">\(b' + a' \cdot s \approx Q \cdot s^2\)</span>，实际等式为 <span class="math inline">\(b' + a' \cdot s = Q \cdot s^2 + e'\)</span>（其中 <span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(evk\)</span> 的生成噪声）。</p>
<p><strong>详细推导</strong>：</p>
<p>计算重线性化后的第一分量 <span class="math inline">\(c_0'\)</span> 对解密的贡献：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\frac{d_2 \cdot b'}{Q} 
&amp;= \frac{d_2 \cdot (-a' \cdot s + e' + Q \cdot s^2)}{Q} \\
&amp;= \frac{-d_2 \cdot a' \cdot s}{Q} + \frac{d_2 \cdot e'}{Q} + d_2 \cdot s^2
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>类似地，第二分量 <span class="math inline">\(c_1'\)</span> 对解密的贡献（乘以 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 后）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{d_2 \cdot a'}{Q} \cdot s = \frac{d_2 \cdot a' \cdot s}{Q}
\]</div><p></p><p>两者相加时，<span class="math inline">\(\frac{-d_2 \cdot a' \cdot s}{Q}\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{d_2 \cdot a' \cdot s}{Q}\)</span> 相互抵消，剩下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_2 \cdot s^2 + \frac{d_2 \cdot e'}{Q}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>因此重线性化引入的误差为</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[e_{\text{rk}} = \left\lfloor \frac{d_2 \cdot e'}{Q} \right\rceil
\]</div><p></p><p>（加上舍入符号表示实际计算中的整数舍入）。由于除以了 <span class="math inline">\(Q\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{rk}}\)</span> 通常比 <span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span> 小得多，但会贡献到总误差中。</p>
<h4 id="523-乘法算法">5.2.3 乘法算法</h4>
<p><strong>CKKS.Mult</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(ct_1\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(ct_2\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(evk\)</span>):</p>
<ol>
<li>计算 <span class="math inline">\((d_0, d_1, d_2)\)</span> 如上</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{mult}} = \text{Relinearize}((d_0, d_1, d_2), evk)\)</span></li>
<li>返回 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{mult}}\)</span></li>
</ol>
<h4 id="524-正确性与误差分析">5.2.4 正确性与误差分析</h4>
<p><strong>定理 5.2</strong>（乘法正确性）：若 <span class="math inline">\(ct_1\)</span> 解密为 <span class="math inline">\(\tilde{m}_1 = m_1 + e_1\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(ct_2\)</span> 解密为 <span class="math inline">\(\tilde{m}_2 = m_2 + e_2\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{mult}}\)</span> 解密为 <span class="math inline">\(m_1 \cdot m_2 + e_{\text{mult}}\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：由解密定义，<span class="math inline">\(c_0^{(i)} + c_1^{(i)} \cdot s = \tilde{m}_i = m_i + e_i\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(i=1,2\)</span>）。朴素乘法后的三元组满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_0 + d_1 s + d_2 s^2 = (c_0^{(1)} + c_1^{(1)} s)(c_0^{(2)} + c_1^{(2)} s) = \tilde{m}_1 \cdot \tilde{m}_2 = (m_1 + e_1)(m_2 + e_2)
\]</div><p></p><p>展开得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[m_1 m_2 + \underbrace{m_1 e_2 + m_2 e_1 + e_1 e_2}_{\text{乘法噪声}}
\]</div><p></p><p>重线性化将三元组转换为二元组 <span class="math inline">\((c_0', c_1')\)</span>，保持解密值近似不变（引入额外小的重线性化误差 <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{rk}}\)</span>）。因此：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0' + c_1' \cdot s \approx m_1 m_2 + e_{\text{mult}}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{mult}} = m_1 e_2 + m_2 e_1 + e_1 e_2 + e_{\text{rk}}\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>误差增长</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|e_{\text{mult}}\| \approx N \cdot \|e_1\| \cdot \|e_2\|
\]</div><p></p><p>（系数 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 来自多项式乘法的范数增长）。误差呈平方级增长，这是限制乘法深度的主要原因。</p>
<h3 id="53-明文-密文运算">5.3 明文-密文运算</h3>
<p>当其中一个操作数是明文（未加密的多项式）时，运算更高效：</p>
<p><strong>明文-密文乘法</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Mult}_{\text{plain}}(ct, m) = (c_0 \cdot m, c_1 \cdot m)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>正确性验证</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(c_0 \cdot m) + (c_1 \cdot m) \cdot s = (c_0 + c_1 \cdot s) \cdot m = \tilde{m}_{\text{ct}} \cdot m
\]</div><p></p><p>解密后得到明文乘积，且噪声只被乘了 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span>（线性增长，而非密文乘法的平方增长）。</p>
<p><strong>明文-密文加法</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Add}_{\text{plain}}(ct, m) = (c_0 + m, c_1)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>正确性验证</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(c_0 + m) + c_1 \cdot s = (c_0 + c_1 \cdot s) + m = \tilde{m}_{\text{ct}} + m
\]</div><p></p><p>解密后得到明文和，噪声不增加（仍是原密文的噪声）。</p>
<h3 id="54-旋转rotation">5.4 旋转（Rotation）</h3>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：旋转是<strong>可选的高级操作</strong>，不在基础加解密流程中。它用于在 SIMD 槽位之间移动数据，实现如向量内积、矩阵运算等复杂操作。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="541-动机与基本概念">5.4.1 动机与基本概念</h4>
<p>CKKS 使用 SIMD 技术，单次加密可处理 <span class="math inline">\(N/2\)</span> 个复数。考虑计算两个加密向量的内积 <span class="math inline">\(\langle \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{b} \rangle = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i b_i\)</span>：分量乘法可计算 <span class="math inline">\((a_0 b_0, a_1 b_1, \ldots, a_{n-1} b_{n-1})\)</span>，但如何将所有分量求和？</p>
<p><strong>解决方案</strong>：通过旋转实现"循环累加"。设 <span class="math inline">\(ct_{ab}\)</span> 加密分量乘积 <span class="math inline">\((a_0 b_0, a_1 b_1, a_2 b_2, a_3 b_3)\)</span>：</p>
<pre><code>第0步: ct_ab = (a0b0, a1b1, a2b2, a3b3)
第1步: 旋转后相加 → (a0b0+a1b1, a1b1+a2b2, a2b2+a3b3, a3b3+a0b0)
第2步: 再旋转后相加 → (a0b0+a1b1+a2b2+a3b3, ...) ← 每个槽位都是内积！
</code></pre>
<p>旋转的核心价值在于：<strong>在密文上实现数据重排，从而完成复杂的向量运算</strong>。</p>
<h4 id="542-自同构映射与旋转密钥">5.4.2 自同构映射与旋转密钥</h4>
<p><strong>自同构映射</strong></p>
<p><strong>定义 5.1</strong>（自同构映射）：对于奇数 <span class="math inline">\(k \in \mathbb{Z}_{2N}^*\)</span>（即 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(2N\)</span> 互素），定义映射：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\tau_k: R \to R, \quad a(X) \mapsto a(X^k) \pmod{X^N + 1}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>引理 5.1</strong>（自同构的性质）：<span class="math inline">\(\tau_k\)</span> 是环自同构，即对任意 <span class="math inline">\(a, b \in R\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(a + b) = \tau_k(a) + \tau_k(b)\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(a \cdot b) = \tau_k(a) \cdot \tau_k(b)\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：由多项式运算的线性性和乘法对 <span class="math inline">\(X^k\)</span> 替换的保持性直接得出。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>命题 5.1</strong>（自同构实现槽位置换）：设 <span class="math inline">\(m(X)\)</span> 是明文多项式，定义<strong>槽位索引</strong> <span class="math inline">\(i \in \{0, 1, \ldots, N-1\}\)</span> 对应根 <span class="math inline">\(\zeta^{2i+1}\)</span>，即第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个槽位存储 <span class="math inline">\(m(\zeta^{2i+1})\)</span>。则自同构 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k\)</span> 作用后，槽位 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的值移动到槽位 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(2i+1)k \equiv 2j+1 \pmod{2N}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>证明</strong>：计算 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(m)(\zeta^{2i+1}) = m(\zeta^{(2i+1)k \mod 2N})\)</span>。由于 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 是奇数，<span class="math inline">\((2i+1)k\)</span> 仍是奇数，故存在 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\((2i+1)k \equiv 2j+1 \pmod{2N}\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<hr>
<p><strong>为什么 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 必须满足特定条件？</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{条件} &amp; \text{原因} \\
\hline
k \text{ 为奇数} &amp; \text{根的指数都是奇数 } (1, 3, 5, \ldots, 2N-1)\text{，} k \text{ 为奇数保证 } (2i+1)k \mod 2N \text{ 仍是奇数} \\
k \text{ 与 } 2N \text{ 互素} &amp; \text{保证映射 } j \mapsto jk \pmod{2N} \text{ 是双射（置换），即可逆}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>例 5.1</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(N=4\)</span>，取 <span class="math inline">\(k=3\)</span>。计算 <span class="math inline">\((2i+1) \cdot 3 \mod 8\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(i=0\)</span>: <span class="math inline">\(1 \times 3 = 3 \to j=1\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(i=1\)</span>: <span class="math inline">\(3 \times 3 = 9 \equiv 1 \to j=0\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(i=2\)</span>: <span class="math inline">\(5 \times 3 = 15 \equiv 7 \to j=3\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(i=3\)</span>: <span class="math inline">\(7 \times 3 = 21 \equiv 5 \to j=2\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_3\)</span> 实现置换：槽位 <span class="math inline">\((z_0, z_1, z_2, z_3) \to (z_1, z_0, z_3, z_2)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>旋转密钥与算法</strong></p>
<p><strong>问题</strong>：直接对密文应用 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k\)</span> 得到 <span class="math inline">\((\tau_k(c_0), \tau_k(c_1))\)</span>，但解密需要 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(s)\)</span> 而非 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\tau_k(c_0) + \tau_k(c_1) \cdot s \neq \tau_k(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s) = \tau_k(m + e)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>解决方案</strong>：通过旋转密钥实现密钥切换。</p>
<p><strong>定义 5.2</strong>（旋转密钥）：对于自同构参数 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>，旋转密钥 <span class="math inline">\(rk_k = (b_k, a_k)\)</span> 定义为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[b_k = -a_k \cdot s + e_k + P \cdot \tau_k(s) \in R_{PQ}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(a_k \leftarrow R_{PQ}\)</span> 均匀随机，<span class="math inline">\(e_k \leftarrow \chi_{\text{err}}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 是特殊模数。</p>
<p><strong>性质</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(b_k + a_k \cdot s = e_k + P \cdot \tau_k(s) \approx P \cdot \tau_k(s)\)</span>。即 <span class="math inline">\(rk_k\)</span> 将 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(s)\)</span> "放大" <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 倍存储。</p>
<p><strong>安全性</strong>：旋转密钥可公开，安全性基于 RLWE 假设。<span class="math inline">\((b_k, a_k)\)</span> 与均匀随机对不可区分。</p>
<p><strong>算法 5.1</strong>（旋转）：</p>
<p><strong>输入</strong>：密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct = (c_0, c_1) \in R_q^2\)</span>，自同构参数 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>，旋转密钥 <span class="math inline">\(rk_k = (b_k, a_k)\)</span></p>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：旋转后的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct' = (c_0', c_1')\)</span></p>
<ol>
<li>计算自同构：<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{c}_0 = \tau_k(c_0)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{c}_1 = \tau_k(c_1)\)</span></li>
<li>模数提升：将 <span class="math inline">\(\tilde{c}_1\)</span> 从模 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 零扩展到模 <span class="math inline">\(PQ\)</span></li>
<li>密钥切换：<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0' = \tilde{c}_0 + \left\lfloor \frac{\tilde{c}_1 \cdot b_k}{P} \right\rceil \pmod{q}, \quad c_1' = \left\lfloor \frac{\tilde{c}_1 \cdot a_k}{P} \right\rceil \pmod{q}
\]</div><p></p></li>
<li>返回 <span class="math inline">\((c_0', c_1')\)</span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>定理 5.3</strong>（旋转正确性）：设 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 加密明文 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span>（带噪声 <span class="math inline">\(e\)</span>），则旋转后的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct'\)</span> 解密得到 <span class="math inline">\(\tau_k(m) + \tau_k(e) + e_{\text{rot}}\)</span>，其中旋转噪声 <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{rot}} = \lfloor \tilde{c}_1 \cdot e_k / P \rceil\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
c_0' + c_1' \cdot s 
&amp;= \tilde{c}_0 + \frac{\tilde{c}_1 \cdot (b_k + a_k \cdot s)}{P} + e_{\text{round}} \\
&amp;= \tilde{c}_0 + \frac{\tilde{c}_1 \cdot (P \cdot \tau_k(s) + e_k)}{P} + e_{\text{round}} \\
&amp;= \tau_k(c_0) + \tau_k(c_1) \cdot \tau_k(s) + \underbrace{\frac{\tilde{c}_1 \cdot e_k}{P}}_{e_{\text{rot}}} + e_{\text{round}} \\
&amp;= \tau_k(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s) + e_{\text{rot}} + e_{\text{round}} \\
&amp;= \tau_k(m + e) + e_{\text{rot}} + e_{\text{round}}
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{round}}\)</span> 是舍入误差，可忽略。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>旋转步长与自同构参数的映射</strong></p>
<p><strong>定义 5.3</strong>（旋转步长）：<strong>旋转步长</strong> <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 指槽位向右移动的位数，即 <span class="math inline">\(r=1\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\((z_0, z_1, \ldots) \to (z_{n-1}, z_0, \ldots)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>命题 5.2</strong>（旋转步长与自同构参数）：旋转步长 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 对应的自同构参数 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[k \equiv 5^r \pmod{2N}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>映射表</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(N=16\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(n=8\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{旋转步长 } r &amp; \text{自同构参数 } k &amp; \text{效果} \\
\hline
1 &amp; 5 &amp; \text{右移 1 位} \\
2 &amp; 9 &amp; \text{右移 2 位} \\
3 &amp; 13 &amp; \text{右移 3 位}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p><strong>注</strong>：由于循环性质，只需 <span class="math inline">\(n-1\)</span> 个不同的旋转密钥。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="543-旋转算法与应用">5.4.3 旋转算法与应用</h4>
<p><strong>向量内积算法</strong></p>
<p><strong>算法 5.2</strong>（向量内积 - 对数算法）：</p>
<p><strong>输入</strong>：加密向量 <span class="math inline">\(ct_a\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(ct_b\)</span></p>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：加密 <span class="math inline">\(\langle \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{b} \rangle\)</span> 的密文（每个槽位都包含结果）</p>
<ol>
<li><span class="math inline">\(ct \leftarrow ct_a \cdot ct_b\)</span></li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(j = 0, 1, \ldots, \log_2(n) - 1\)</span>：
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(ct_{\text{rot}} \leftarrow \text{Rotate}(ct, 2^j)\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(ct \leftarrow ct + ct_{\text{rot}}\)</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>返回 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>原理</strong>：二分归约思想。每轮将相邻的 <span class="math inline">\(2^j\)</span> 个元素配对相加，经过 <span class="math inline">\(\log_2(n)\)</span> 轮后每个槽位都包含总和。</p>
<p><strong>例 5.2</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(n=8\)</span>）：</p>
<pre><code>初始:     (p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7)
旋转1步:  (p7, p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
相加:     (p0+p7, p1+p0, p2+p1, p3+p2, p4+p3, p5+p4, p6+p5, p7+p6)
旋转2步:  (p6+p5, p7+p6, p0+p7, p1+p0, ...)
相加:     (p0+p1+p6+p7, ...)
旋转4步:  (p4+p5+p6+p7, ...)
相加:     (p0+p1+...+p7, ...) ← 每个槽位都是总和
</code></pre>
<p><strong>复杂度</strong>：朴素算法需 <span class="math inline">\(n-1\)</span> 次旋转，对数算法仅需 <span class="math inline">\(\log_2(n)\)</span> 次。对于 <span class="math inline">\(n=1024\)</span>，从 1023 次降至 10 次。</p>
<p><strong>复杂度分析与优化</strong></p>
<p><strong>复杂度</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作} &amp; \text{时间复杂度} &amp; \text{相对耗时} \\
\hline
\text{加法} &amp; O(N) &amp; 1x \\
\text{明文乘法} &amp; O(N \log N) &amp; \sim 10x \\
\text{密文乘法} &amp; O(N \log N) &amp; \sim 100x \\
\text{旋转} &amp; O(N \log N) &amp; \sim 50x
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>优化技巧</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Baby-Step Giant-Step</strong>：用 <span class="math inline">\(O(\sqrt{n})\)</span> 个密钥支持所有旋转。设 <span class="math inline">\(m = \lceil \sqrt{n} \rceil\)</span>，预生成 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 个小步密钥（旋转 <span class="math inline">\(1, 2, 4, \ldots\)</span> 步）和 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 个大步密钥（旋转 <span class="math inline">\(m, 2m, \ldots\)</span> 步），任意旋转 <span class="math inline">\(r = q \cdot m + rem\)</span> 可分解为小步+大步。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>惰性旋转</strong>：连续旋转 <span class="math inline">\(r_1\)</span> 步和 <span class="math inline">\(r_2\)</span> 步可合并为一次旋转 <span class="math inline">\((r_1 + r_2) \mod n\)</span> 步，减少噪声累积。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<p><strong>与重线性化的统一视角</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作} &amp; \text{问题} &amp; \text{解决方案} \\
\hline
\text{重线性化} &amp; \text{解密需要 } s^2 &amp; \text{用 } evk \text{ 把 } d_2 \cdot s^2 \text{ 转换为只需要 } s \\
\text{旋转} &amp; \text{解密需要 } \tau_k(s) &amp; \text{用 } rk_k \text{ 把 } \tilde{c}_1 \cdot \tau_k(s) \text{ 转换为只需要 } s
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p>两者都是<strong>密钥切换</strong>技术的应用：通过预先生成的辅助密钥，把需要"新密钥"的项转换为只需要"原密钥"的形式。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="重缩放与模数切换">重缩放与模数切换</h2>
<h3 id="61-重缩放rescaling">6.1 重缩放（Rescaling）</h3>
<h4 id="611-问题背景">6.1.1 问题背景</h4>
<p>回顾 <a href="#42-%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81encoding" rel="noopener nofollow">4.2 编码</a> 中引入的缩放因子 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>：编码时将明文乘以 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span> 以控制精度。因此，加密的明文实际上是 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta \cdot m\)</span>。</p>
<p>乘法后，缩放因子平方：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Mult}(\Delta \cdot m_1, \Delta \cdot m_2) \approx \Delta^2 \cdot m_1 m_2
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="612-重缩放操作">6.1.2 重缩放操作</h4>
<p><strong>CKKS.Rescale</strong>(<span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(\ell\)</span>):</p>
<p>输入：层级 <span class="math inline">\(\ell\)</span> 的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct \in R_{q_\ell}^2\)</span><br>
输出：层级 <span class="math inline">\(\ell-1\)</span> 的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct' \in R_{q_{\ell-1}}^2\)</span></p>
<ol>
<li>计算 <span class="math inline">\(ct' = \left\lfloor \frac{q_{\ell-1}}{q_\ell} \cdot ct \right\rceil \pmod{q_{\ell-1}}\)</span></li>
<li>输出 <span class="math inline">\(ct'\)</span></li>
</ol>
<h4 id="613-重缩放的数学原理">6.1.3 重缩放的数学原理</h4>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(q_\ell = q_{\ell-1} \cdot q^*\)</span>，则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Rescale}(ct) = \frac{1}{q^*} ct + \epsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>若 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 加密 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta^2 \cdot m\)</span>，重缩放后：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\approx \frac{\Delta^2}{q^*} \cdot m = \Delta \cdot m \quad \text{(当 } q^* \approx \Delta\text{)}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>定理 6.1</strong>（重缩放正确性）：若 <span class="math inline">\(q^* \approx \Delta\)</span>，重缩放恢复正确的缩放因子。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 加密 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta^2 \cdot m\)</span>，即 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = \Delta^2 \cdot m + e\)</span>。重缩放操作计算 <span class="math inline">\(ct' = \lfloor ct / q^* \rceil\)</span>，因此：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0' + c_1' \cdot s \approx \frac{\Delta^2}{q^*} \cdot m + \frac{e}{q^*} \approx \Delta \cdot m + e'
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(e' = e / q^*\)</span> 是新的噪声。由于 <span class="math inline">\(q^* \approx \Delta\)</span>，缩放因子恢复为 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<h3 id="62-模数链设计">6.2 模数链设计</h3>
<h4 id="621-层级结构">6.2.1 层级结构</h4>
<p>设总共有 <span class="math inline">\(L+1\)</span> 个层级，模数链为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[Q_L \to Q_{L-1} \to \cdots \to Q_0
\]</div><p></p><p>其中：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[Q_\ell = q_\ell \cdot q_{\ell-1} \cdots q_0 = \prod_{i=0}^{\ell} q_i
\]</div><p></p><p>通常选择 <span class="math inline">\(q_i \approx \Delta\)</span>（如 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta = 2^{30}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(q_i = 2^{30}\)</span>）。</p>
<h4 id="622-层级变化">6.2.2 层级变化</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作} &amp; \text{层级变化} &amp; \text{缩放因子变化} \\
\hline
\text{加密} &amp; \ell &amp; \Delta \\
\text{加法} &amp; \ell \to \ell &amp; \Delta \to \Delta \\
\text{乘法} &amp; \ell \to \ell &amp; \Delta \to \Delta^2 \\
\text{重缩放} &amp; \ell \to \ell-1 &amp; \Delta^2 \to \Delta
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="623-模数消耗与乘法深度">6.2.3 模数消耗与乘法深度</h4>
<p><strong>定义 6.1</strong>（乘法深度）：设 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 是一个算术电路。<span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 的<strong>乘法深度</strong>定义为从输入到输出的任意有向路径上乘法门的最大数量，记为 <span class="math inline">\(\text{depth}(f)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>例 6.1</strong>（乘法深度）：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(x,y) = x \cdot y\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(\text{depth}(f) = 1\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(x,y,z) = x \cdot y \cdot z\)</span>：分解为 <span class="math inline">\(t = x \cdot y\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(f = t \cdot z\)</span>，故 <span class="math inline">\(\text{depth}(f) = 2\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(x) = a_0 + a_1 x + a_2 x^2\)</span>（Horner 形式 <span class="math inline">\(a_0 + x(a_1 + a_2 x)\)</span>）：<span class="math inline">\(\text{depth}(f) = 2\)</span></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>引理 6.1</strong>（模数消耗）：设密文初始层级为 <span class="math inline">\(\ell\)</span>，乘法深度为 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span>。若 <span class="math inline">\(d &gt; \ell\)</span>，则计算无法完成。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：设密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 在层级 <span class="math inline">\(\ell\)</span>，缩放因子为 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>。</p>
<p>乘法操作：<span class="math inline">\(ct_1 \cdot ct_2 \to ct_{\text{new}}\)</span>，缩放因子变为 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta^2\)</span>。</p>
<p>重缩放操作：<span class="math inline">\(\text{Rescale}(ct_{\text{new}}) = \lfloor ct_{\text{new}} / q_\ell \rceil\)</span>，缩放因子恢复为 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\)</span>，层级降为 <span class="math inline">\(\ell - 1\)</span>。</p>
<p>因此，每次乘法+重缩放消耗一个模数因子。<span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 次乘法需要 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 个模数因子。若 <span class="math inline">\(d &gt; \ell\)</span>，模数耗尽，计算失败。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<p><strong>推论 6.1</strong>（模数链长度要求）：计算乘法深度为 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 的电路，需要模数链长度 <span class="math inline">\(L \geq d\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="63-自举bootstrapping">6.3 自举（Bootstrapping）</h3>
<h4 id="631-自举原理">6.3.1 自举原理</h4>
<p><strong>问题陈述</strong></p>
<p><strong>设定</strong>：设模数链为 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L &gt; Q_{L-1} &gt; \cdots &gt; Q_0\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(Q_\ell = \prod_{i=0}^{\ell} q_i\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>问题</strong>：给定层级 0 的密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct \in R_{Q_0}^2\)</span>，如何恢复到更高层级以继续计算？</p>
<p><strong>定义 6.2</strong>（自举）：自举的作用是把层级 0 的密文"刷新"成顶层 <span class="math inline">\(L\)</span> 的密文，明文内容不变，但噪声被重置，模数链恢复，可以继续计算。</p>
<h4 id="632-ckks-自举构造">6.3.2 CKKS 自举构造</h4>
<p><strong>输入</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(ct = (c_0, c_1) \in R_{Q_0}^2\)</span>，满足 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = m + e \pmod{Q_0}\)</span></p>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(ct' = (c_0', c_1') \in R_{Q_L}^2\)</span>，满足 <span class="math inline">\(c_0' + c_1' \cdot s' = m + e' \pmod{Q_L}\)</span></p>
<hr>
<p><strong>第一步：模数提升</strong></p>
<p>将密文从模 <span class="math inline">\(Q_0\)</span> 提升到模 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span>。系数不变，只是模数扩大：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ct^{(1)} = (c_0 \bmod Q_L,\; c_1 \bmod Q_L) \in R_{Q_L}^2
\]</div><p></p><p>此时 <span class="math inline">\(ct^{(1)}\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = m + e \pmod{Q_0}
\]</div><p></p><p>但模数已变为 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span>，为后续计算提供了空间。</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>第二步：同态解密</strong></p>
<p>模数提升后，密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct^{(1)} = (c_0, c_1)\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = m + e \pmod{Q_0}
\]</div><p></p><p>目标是计算 <span class="math inline">\(m + e\)</span> 然后用新公钥重新加密。但服务器没有私钥 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>，无法直接计算 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>解决方法</strong>：客户端生成新的密钥对 <span class="math inline">\((s', pk')\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(s'\)</span> 是新私钥，<span class="math inline">\(pk'\)</span> 是新公钥。然后构造自举密钥 <span class="math inline">\(bsk = \text{Enc}_{pk'}(s)\)</span>，即用新公钥加密原私钥。服务器利用CKKS的同态性质，在密文上"模拟"解密过程。</p>
<p>解密函数 <span class="math inline">\(\text{Dec}_s(ct) = c_0 + c_1 \cdot s\)</span> 是关于 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 的一次多项式。服务器有：</p>
<ul>
<li>密文分量 <span class="math inline">\(c_0, c_1\)</span>（这些是模 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span> 下的多项式系数，可视为明文）</li>
<li>加密的私钥 <span class="math inline">\(bsk = \text{Enc}_{pk'}(s)\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>利用同态数乘（明文乘密文）和同态加法：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0) + c_1 \cdot bsk = \text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0) + \text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_1 \cdot s) = \text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s)
\]</div><p></p><p>这里 <span class="math inline">\(c_0, c_1\)</span> 作为明文系数与密文进行运算。</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>第三步：多项式近似</strong></p>
<p>上述计算得到 <span class="math inline">\(\text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s)\)</span>，但 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s\)</span> 可能很大（因为模数提升到了 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span>），我们需要的是 <span class="math inline">\((c_0 + c_1 \cdot s) \bmod Q_0 = m + e\)</span>。</p>
<p>模约简函数 <span class="math inline">\(f(x) = x \bmod Q_0\)</span> 包含取整操作，不是多项式，无法直接同态计算。因此需要找一个多项式 <span class="math inline">\(P(x)\)</span> 来近似 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>多项式近似方法</strong>：<br>
模约简函数 <span class="math inline">\(f(x) = x - Q_0 \cdot \lfloor x/Q_0 \rceil\)</span> 是周期为 <span class="math inline">\(Q_0\)</span> 的锯齿波。可以用以下方法近似：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>正弦函数近似</strong>：<span class="math inline">\(f(x) \approx \frac{Q_0}{2\pi} \sin(\frac{2\pi x}{Q_0})\)</span>，然后用 Taylor 展开得到多项式</li>
<li><strong>Chebyshev 多项式</strong>：在区间 <span class="math inline">\([-Q_L/2, Q_L/2]\)</span> 上最小化最大误差</li>
</ol>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(P(x) = \sum_{i=0}^{d} a_i x^i\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 次近似多项式，满足 <span class="math inline">\(|P(x) - (x \bmod Q_0)| \leq \epsilon_P\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>同态求值</strong>：由于 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 是多项式，可以用同态加法和同态乘法计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[P(\text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s)) = \sum_{i=0}^{d} a_i \cdot (\text{Enc}_{pk'}(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s))^i = \text{Enc}_{pk'}(P(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s))
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\((\cdot)^i\)</span> 通过 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 次同态乘法实现。最终：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ct' = \text{Enc}_{pk'}((m + e) + \epsilon)
\]</div><p></p><p>近似误差 <span class="math inline">\(|\epsilon| \leq \epsilon_P\)</span>。结果 <span class="math inline">\(ct'\)</span> 是新公钥 <span class="math inline">\(pk'\)</span> 下的密文，对应私钥 <span class="math inline">\(s'\)</span>，模数链恢复到顶层 <span class="math inline">\(L\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>自举正确性</strong></p>
<p><strong>定理 6.3</strong>（CKKS 自举正确性）：设输入密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct\)</span> 满足 <span class="math inline">\(c_0 + c_1 \cdot s = m + e \pmod{Q_0}\)</span>，多项式近似误差为 <span class="math inline">\(\epsilon_P\)</span>。则自举输出密文 <span class="math inline">\(ct'\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Dec}_{s'}(ct') = m + e'
\]</div><p></p><p>其中噪声 <span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span> 满足 <span class="math inline">\(\|e'\|_\infty \leq \|e\|_\infty + \epsilon_P + e_{\text{eval}}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{eval}}\)</span> 是同态求值引入的噪声。</p>
<p><strong>证明</strong>：设 <span class="math inline">\(x = c_0 + c_1 \cdot s\)</span>。模数提升后，<span class="math inline">\(c_0, c_1\)</span> 在模 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span> 下，<span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 是小系数私钥，因此 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的系数大小约为 <span class="math inline">\(O(Q_L)\)</span>。多项式 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 在区间 <span class="math inline">\([-Q_L, Q_L]\)</span> 上近似模约简函数 <span class="math inline">\(t \mapsto t \bmod Q_0\)</span>。同态计算 <span class="math inline">\(P(x)\)</span> 得到：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[P(x) = (x \bmod Q_0) + \epsilon = m + e + \epsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(\epsilon\)</span> 是近似误差，<span class="math inline">\(\|\epsilon\|_\infty \leq \epsilon_P\)</span>。加上同态求值噪声 <span class="math inline">\(e_{\text{eval}}\)</span>，最终得到 <span class="math inline">\(m + e'\)</span>。<span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<hr>
<h4 id="633-复杂度与优化">6.3.3 复杂度与优化</h4>
<p><strong>自举复杂度</strong></p>
<p><strong>定理 6.4</strong>（自举复杂度）：设多项式 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 的次数为 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span>，则 CKKS 自举需要：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{资源} &amp; \text{复杂度} \\
\hline
\text{同态乘法次数} &amp; O(d) \\
\text{同态加法次数} &amp; O(d) \\
\text{乘法深度} &amp; O(\log d) \text{（使用平方-乘法）} \\
\text{时间} &amp; O(d \cdot N \log N)
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>证明</strong>：多项式 <span class="math inline">\(P(x) = \sum_{i=0}^{d} a_i x^i\)</span> 的同态求值需要计算 <span class="math inline">\(x^i\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(i=0,1,\ldots,d\)</span>）。使用平方-乘法算法，计算 <span class="math inline">\(x^d\)</span> 需要 <span class="math inline">\(O(\log d)\)</span> 次乘法。所有单项式 <span class="math inline">\(x^i\)</span> 可在 <span class="math inline">\(O(d)\)</span> 次乘法内完成。每次乘法的时间复杂度为 <span class="math inline">\(O(N \log N)\)</span>（使用 NTT），总时间为 <span class="math inline">\(O(d \cdot N \log N)\)</span>。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>多项式求值需要 <span class="math inline">\(O(\log d)\)</span> 的乘法深度。这意味着模数链必须有足够的层级来支持这些乘法。CKKS自举要求 <span class="math inline">\(L \geq O(\log d)\)</span>，即顶层模数 <span class="math inline">\(Q_L\)</span> 必须足够大以容纳自举过程中的所有乘法运算。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="附录数学符号速查表">附录：数学符号速查表</h2>
<h3 id="模数符号">模数符号</h3>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{符号} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
Q &amp; \text{总模数（顶层模数链的乘积）} \\
q_\ell &amp; \text{第 } \ell \text{ 层的单个模数因子} \\
Q_\ell = \prod_{i=0}^{\ell} q_i &amp; \text{第 } \ell \text{ 层的累积模数} \\
P &amp; \text{特殊模数（用于密钥切换）} \\
P \cdot Q &amp; \text{扩展模数（用于旋转密钥生成）} \\
q^* &amp; \text{重缩放时除去的模数因子}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="误差符号">误差符号</h3>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{符号} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
e &amp; \text{基础误差（RLWE 误差）} \\
e_{\text{enc}} &amp; \text{加密引入的误差} \\
e_{\text{mult}} &amp; \text{乘法引入的误差} \\
e_{\text{add}} &amp; \text{加法引入的误差} \\
e_{\text{rk}} &amp; \text{重线性化引入的误差} \\
e_{\text{rot}} &amp; \text{旋转引入的误差} \\
e_{\text{boot}} &amp; \text{自举引入的误差} \\
\epsilon &amp; \text{近似误差（如多项式近似误差、舍入误差）}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="其他符号">其他符号</h3>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{符号} &amp; \text{含义} \\
\hline
N &amp; \text{分圆多项式次数（2 的幂）} \\
R = \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^N+1) &amp; \text{分圆多项式环（次数 } &lt; N \text{ 的整系数多项式，满足 } X^N = -1 \text{）} \\
R_q = \mathbb{Z}_q[X]/(X^N+1) &amp; \text{模 } q \text{ 分圆多项式环（系数 } \in \mathbb{Z}_q\text{，次数 } &lt; N\text{，满足 } X^N = -1 \text{）} \\
\chi &amp; \text{通用分布} \\
\chi_{\text{key}} &amp; \text{密钥分布（通常为 HWHM 分布）} \\
\chi_{\text{err}} &amp; \text{误差分布（通常为离散高斯分布）} \\
\Delta &amp; \text{缩放因子} \\
\tilde{m} &amp; \text{带噪声的明文} \\
ct &amp; \text{密文（用下标区分，如 } ct_1, ct_{\text{add}} \text{）} \\
\sigma &amp; \text{规范嵌入映射} \\
\zeta &amp; 2N \text{ 次本原单位根} \\
\mathbb{Z}_{2N}^* &amp; \text{模 } 2N \text{ 的乘法群（与 } 2N \text{ 互素的剩余类，即所有奇数）} \\
\tau_k &amp; \text{自同构映射} \\
\odot &amp; \text{分量乘法（Hadamard 积）}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p>

</div>
